findings: s(List,StateCallback,Handler) constructs OutputConfigurations and SessionConfiguration on its API28+ branch; also retains a legacy surface-list createCaptureSession branch.
J0() creates a request, adds the still ImageReader surface and submits through the camera wrapper.
Q0(Image,TotalCaptureResult) distinguishes JPEG format 256 and format 35. Its format35 branch allocates width*height*3/2 bytes and converts to PIXEL_FORMAT_NV21 before onPictureTaken.
A P010 source must take ownership before this Q0 conversion route; relabeling P010 as YUV420 or passing it to the old NV21 consumer would not preserve 10 bits.
